decisions.reason: Close to core and low keeping cost, so the option remains open while demand uncertainty still exists.
Pegboard variant is an incremental extension with low keeping cost, so the firm keeps the option until market signal emerges.
It overlaps with other quarter-pallet displays, reducing its marginal option value, so the firm abandons this redundant option.
Eighth-pallet display is close to established products and inexpensive to retain, so the option is kept open.
The wooden pallet is a larger step from the core cardboard offer, and after several years its prospects remain unclear while keeping costs are higher, so the option is dropped.
